scope: Clamped loaded continuous elastic boom and fin with live aerodynamic feedback at 1 Hz, compared with full native equations on two meshes.
inputs: physical upper fin tip Mz unit
limitations: Each mesh uses independently manufactured fixed aerodynamic base counterloads. This is not a common-load aircraft mesh-convergence study.
Boom aerodynamic radius is removed; boom structural properties and inertia remain. Gravity, propulsion and aircraft free-frame coupling are excluded from this component.
The 1% criterion is a scaled complex relative infinity norm per output group and input, not a pointwise relative error bound.
The coarse comparison and corrected base-geometry discrepancies are descriptive only.
Raw evidence and new reference/adapter sources remain in the local staging directory; durable regression and portable evidence packaging are pending.
